Only when the games are not in one collection folder (each dumped on its own). A game with a folder here is taken from it; the others from the collection folder above.

Temporal reconstruction with the games' own motion vectors: smoother edges and less shimmering than the games' own. Native AA keeps 1920 × 1080; a preset below renders smaller and reconstructs 1920 × 1080. DLSS needs a GeForce RTX (Super Resolution works on RTX 20 series and newer); FSR 4 runs best on a Radeon RX 7000/9000 or a GeForce RTX 40/50. Intel XeSS runs on any GPU.
The folder with eboot.bin, big2-ps4_Shipping.elf and big3-ps4_Shipping.elf. Leave it empty if every game has a folder of its own, below.
The games' own trophy lists. A trophy shows here, and as a notice in the game, when you earn it.

The pictures of buttons in menus and hints. Automatic shows your keys while you use the keyboard or mouse, Xbox buttons after an Xbox (or other) controller, and the PlayStation buttons after a PlayStation controller.
The setting applies the next time the game starts.
The size the games draw at, so a 1440p or 4K screen gets a sharper picture, not an enlarged 1080p one. It needs more graphics memory and a faster GPU; the games' GPU memory limits the largest size.
The window the picture is shown in; fullscreen uses the screen. A picture of another size is scaled to fit (FSR 1 below when it is enlarged).
This image could not be opened: {}

Ultrawide screens: the games draw a wider view (more at the sides) instead of stretching the 16:9 picture. "The shape of the window or screen" follows the window size below, or the screen in fullscreen.
Unavailable while the game is running.
Use one image and adjust each Steam format separately.

What the games are told the speakers are, which sets the choices in their Audio Output menu (stereo, 5.1, 7.1). Automatic follows the Windows speaker configuration of the default playback device; set it to 5.1 or 7.1 when the games only offer stereo.

What the upscaler renders and then reconstructs to 1920 × 1080. Quality is 1280 × 720: DLSS Super Resolution turns that into a 1920 × 1080 image, which is real upscaling, unlike Native AA. Frame generation stays off unless you choose it below.
